Calculating which specicies had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain
```{r}
Human <- sum(180,83,57,110)
Pig <- sum(109,157,31,45)
Mouse <- sum(55,185,60,98)


print(paste("Humans had", Human, "Pigs had", Pig, "and mice had", Mouse))
print(paste("Therefore Humans had the greatest regionally elevated expression in their forebrain"))
```
